rationale: Sam's answers are mostly natural and fit a relaxed, practical outpatient who likes repairs. In turn 1 Sam is expressive and concrete about the clock. In turn 2 Sam reasonably asks which person the ambiguous 'she' means, and turn 12 adds a casual afterthought. Short, consistent answers to the repeated radio questions (turns 7–9) are also plausible. Several elements fall short of full authenticity. The profile says Sam 'often has a small story to contribute' and sometimes follows side associations, but neither appears; answers stay tightly on-question and tend to recite facts. Turn 6's self-observation reads like a stated profile trait rather than something said spontaneously. Turn 10 echoes the question almost word for word in a flat way. These are minor and don't badly undermine realism.
